items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: "Where's Captain Barry --," I think it was. "Where's Captain Barry?" Said, "I don't know, sir, he was around here a little while ago. But I think he'll be back."

ctx.x: "Even if it means going to jail." He said, "You go to jail. Don't come over here." Because my brother went all the way across the channel, clean on to Berlin with General Patton, and he saw the worst of it. He came back from the war with six battle stars. Yes, sir.

So, getting back, Colonel Gardine -- now, imagine, to show you how tight our outfit were, we were in a clearing. You know, we'd get up in the morning and build a fire and sit around the fire, in the winter, cold you know. So I saw these bushes, and lo and behold here comes the Colonel, Colonel Gardine. You know, he made out like it was an official visit. So everybody jumped up and stood at attention. He said, "As you were. At ease." He says, "Where's --," What was the Captain's name?
